headlines.summary: 2026年8月31日至9月1日，潘功胜行长在出席二十国集团（G20）财长和央行行长会议期间，分别会见了国际货币基金组织总裁格奥尔基耶娃、美国财政部长贝森特、美联储主席沃什、欧央行行长拉加德、加拿大央行行长麦克勒姆、韩国央行行长申铉松、阿根廷经济部长卡普托和央行行长鲍希利，就全球经济形势、深化双边金融合作等议题交换了意见。

headlines.title_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng Meets International Financial Institution Leaders and Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors from Relevant Countries
headlines.summary_en: During the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting held from August 31 to September 1, 2026, Governor Pan Gongsheng met separately with IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva, U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh, ECB President Christine Lagarde, Bank of Canada Governor Tiff Macklem, Bank of Korea Governor Rhee Chang-yong, Argentine Economy Minister Luis Caputo, and Central Bank of Argentina Governor Santiago Bausili, exchanging views on the global economic situation and deepening bilateral financial cooperation.

headlines.title: 中国央行8月公开市场国债买卖净投放500亿元
headlines.summary: 中国央行公布2026年8月各项工具流动性投放情况，中央银行贷款方面，中期借贷便利（MLF）净回笼1000亿元，抵押补充贷款（PSL）净回笼521亿元，其他结构性货币政策工具净投放650亿元；公开市场业务方面，隔夜、7天期逆回购净回笼6415亿元，公开市场国债买卖净投放500亿元；中央国库现金管理净投放700亿元。

headlines.title_en: China's Central Bank Conducts Net Injection of 50 Billion Yuan via Open Market Government Bond Operations in August
headlines.summary_en: China's central bank released the liquidity provision situation of various tools in August 2026. In central bank lending, the medium-term lending facility (MLF) saw a net withdrawal of 100 billion yuan, pledged supplementary lending (PSL) saw a net withdrawal of 52.1 billion yuan, and other structural monetary policy tools saw a net injection of 65 billion yuan. In open market operations, overnight and 7-day reverse repurchases saw a net withdrawal of 641.5 billion yuan, open market treasury bond trading saw a net injection of 50 billion yuan, and central treasury cash management saw a net injection of 70 billion yuan.

headlines.title: 潘功胜：中方从不刻意追求贸易顺差，坚持扩大内需、坚持高水平对外开
headlines.summary: 中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席二十国集团财长和央行行长会议。潘功胜指出，贸易摩擦和保护主义通过影响供应链、推升通胀、扰乱市场预期等因素拖累全球经济。各方应坚定维护多边主义，充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。解决主权债务问题应坚持“共同行动、公平负担”原则。G20应发挥引领作用，确保各方在共同框架下有效落实“待遇可比”原则。经济增长是化解发展中国家债务问题、恢复债务可持续性的根本出路。

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: China Never Deliberately Seeks Trade Surpluses, Remains Committed to Expanding Domestic Demand and High-Level Opening-Up
headlines.summary_en: PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting. Pan noted that trade frictions and protectionism are weighing on the global economy through factors such as impacting supply chains, pushing up inflation, and disrupting market expectations. All parties should firmly uphold multilateralism, make full use of the G20 finance and cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and jointly address global risks and challenges. Resolving sovereign debt issues should adhere to the principle of "common action and fair burden-sharing." The G20 should play a leading role in ensuring all parties effectively implement the principle of "comparability of treatment" under the common framework. Economic growth is the fundamental way to resolve developing countries' debt problems and restore debt sustainability.

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: China Has No Necessity or Intention to Gain Trade Competitive Advantage Through Currency Depreciation
headlines.summary_en: [Pan Gongsheng: China has no need and no intention to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation] From August 31 to September 1, PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng stated at the G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting that China implements a managed floating exchange rate system, adheres to the decisive role of the market in exchange rate formation, while preventing market "herd behavior" and the self-reinforcement of irrational expectations. China has no need, and no intention, to gain trade competitive advantage through currency depreciation.

headlines.title: 潘功胜：经济增长是化解发展中国家债务问题、恢复债务可持续性的根本出路
headlines.summary: 【潘功胜：经济增长是化解发展中国家债务问题、恢复债务可持续性的根本出路】8月31日至9月1日，二十国集团（G20）在美国阿什维尔召开今年第二次财长和央行行长会议。中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席会议并发言。潘功胜指出，贸易摩擦和保护主义通过影响供应链、推升通胀、扰乱市场预期等因素拖累全球经济。各方应坚定维护多边主义，充分用好G20财金合作平台，强化宏观经济政策协同，携手应对全球性风险挑战。解决主权债务问题应坚持“共同行动、公平负担”原则。G20应发挥引领作用，确保各方在共同框架下有效落实“待遇可比”原则。经济增长是化解债务问题的根本途径。

headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng: Economic Growth Is the Fundamental Way to Resolve Debt Issues in Developing Countries and Restore Debt Sustainability
headlines.summary_en: [Pan Gongsheng: Economic growth is the fundamental way to resolve developing countries' debt problems and restore debt sustainability] From August 31 to September 1, the G20 held its second Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of the year in Asheville, United States. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended and spoke at the meeting. Pan noted that trade frictions and protectionism are weighing on the global economy through factors such as impacting supply chains, pushing up inflation, and disrupting market expectations. All parties should firmly uphold multilateralism, make full use of the G20 finance and cooperation platform, strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, and jointly address global risks and challenges. Resolving sovereign debt issues should adhere to the principle of "common action and fair burden-sharing." The G20 should play a leading role in ensuring all parties effectively implement the principle of "comparability of treatment" under the common framework. Economic growth is the fundamental way to resolve debt problems.

headlines.summary_zh: 【央行行长潘功胜出席二十国集团财长和央行行长会议】2026年8月31日至9月1日，二十国集团（G20）在美国阿什维尔召开今年第二次财长和央行行长会议。会议讨论了全球经济形势与前景、促进经济增长、全球失衡、发展中国家主权债务等议题。中国人民银行行长潘功胜出席会议并发言。
headlines.title_en: Pan Gongsheng at G20 FM-CBG Meeting: Continue Implementing a Moderately Loose Monetary Policy
headlines.summary_en: [PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attends G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting] From August 31 to September 1, 2026, the G20 held its second Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting of the year in Asheville, United States. The meeting discussed topics including the global economic situation and outlook, promoting economic growth, global imbalances, and sovereign debt of developing countries. PBOC Governor Pan Gongsheng attended and spoke at the meeting.

headlines.title: 外交部：中方对二十国集团财长和央行行长会议未能发表公报深表遗憾
headlines.summary: 外交部发言人郭嘉昆主持例行记者会。有记者提问，据了解，在8月31日至9月1日举行的二十国集团第二次财长和央行行长会议上，因中方对全球失衡问题持不同意见，此次会议未能发表公报。中方对此有何评论？

headlines.title_en: Foreign Ministry: China Deeply Regrets Failure to Issue Communique at G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting
headlines.summary_en: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun held a regular press conference. A reporter asked: It is understood that at the second G20 Finance Ministers and Central Bank Governors Meeting held from August 31 to September 1, the meeting failed to issue a communique because the Chinese side held different views on global imbalances. What is China's comment on this?

headlines.title: 国务院任免国家工作人员：刘桂平任市场监管总局局长
headlines.summary: 国务院任免国家工作人员。任命刘桂平为国家市场监督管理总局局长；任命潘晓东为国家市场监督管理总局副局长。免去孟扬的国家市场监督管理总局副局长职务。（人社部网站）

headlines.title_en: State Council appoints Liu Guiping as head of the State Administration for Market Regulation
headlines.summary_en: The State Council made personnel appointments and removals. Liu Guiping was appointed Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation; Pan Xiaodong was appointed Deputy Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation. Meng Yang was removed from the post of Deputy Director of the State Administration for Market Regulation. (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security website)

headlines.title: 中远海控：8月累计回购1.23亿元
headlines.summary: 中远海控公告，2026年8月，公司通过上海证券交易所交易系统以集中竞价交易方式回购A股股份8,041,020股，占公司截至2026年8月31日总股本的比例为0.053%，购买的最高价为人民币15.40元/股、最低价为人民币15.14元/股，已支付的总金额为人民币123,469,372.50元（不含交易费用）。

headlines.title_en: COSCO Shipping Holdings: Cumulatively repurchased 123 million yuan in August
headlines.summary_en: COSCO Shipping Holdings announced that in August 2026, the company repurchased 8,041,020 A-shares through centralized auction trading on the Shanghai Stock Exchange trading system, accounting for 0.053% of the company's total share capital as of August 31, 2026, with the highest purchase price of 15.40 yuan per share and the lowest price of 15.14 yuan per share, and a total amount paid of 123,469,372.50 yuan (excluding transaction fees).

headlines.title: 五部门将开展第六次中国城乡老年人生活状况抽样调查
headlines.summary: 民政部、中央社会工作部、财政部、全国老龄办、中国老龄协会等五部门日前联合印发通知，将组织开展第六次中国城乡老年人生活状况抽样调查，为深入实施积极应对人口老龄化国家战略，完善相关法律、法规和政策，提供基础数据保障。

headlines.title_en: Five ministries to launch sixth national sampling survey on living conditions of urban and rural elderly in China
headlines.summary_en: Five departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the Central Social Work Department, the Ministry of Finance, the National Office on Aging, and the China National Committee on Aging, recently jointly issued a notice to organize the sixth sample survey of the living conditions of urban and rural elderly in China, providing basic data support for the in-depth implementation of the national strategy to actively respond to population aging and the improvement of relevant laws, regulations, and policies.
